item.title: Dubbo RPC Internals with Nacos Registry
item.description: Dubbo is an RPC framework. A service is defined as an ordinary interface, implemented in a provider process, and called from a consumer process as though it were a local object, with a registry telling the consumer where the provider is and a metadata service telling it what that interface looks like. Dubbo has implementations in Go, Python, PHP, Erlang, Rust, and Node.js, and this post covers the Java one.
